term.section.meaning: Part of the hill with one angle and surface.
term.base.meaning: Safe point where members self-secure, attach ropes and belay.
term.intermediate_base.meaning: A base between start and finish: splits the fixed rope and limits fall length.
term.anchor.meaning: Tree, rock outcrop or bolt a base is built on.
term.fixed_rope.meaning: Rope fixed between bases; others move along it with self-belay.
term.self_belay.meaning: A member's own attachment to a fixed rope or base.
term.belay.meaning: One member protects another with a rope.
term.lower_belay.meaning: Belayer below, climber goes up, rope is paid out.
term.upper_belay.meaning: Belayer above, rope is taken in.
term.leader.meaning: First member who goes up and fixes the rope.
term.last.meaning: Member who removes the ropes and goes last.
term.helmet.meaning: Worn equipment; protects from rocks and in falls.
term.rope.meaning: Rope with a length and diameter.
term.lanyard.meaning: Connects the harness to a rope or base.
term.control_knot.meaning: Prevents the main knot from untying.
term.injury.meaning: In this version an injury loses the game.
knot.pryamyi.name: Square (reef) knot
knot.pryamyi.description: Joins ropes of the same diameter. Symmetric, free ends exit on the same side. Works only under constant load. Needs 2 control knots.
knot.tkatskyi.name: Weaver's knot
knot.tkatskyi.description: Joins ropes of the same diameter. Central knots symmetric, control knots may be asymmetric. Needs 2 control knots.
knot.grapevine.name: Double fisherman's
knot.grapevine.description: Joins ropes of the same diameter and ties cord into a loop. Symmetric, free ends exit diagonally opposite. No control knots needed.
knot.zustrichnyi.name: Water knot
knot.zustrichnyi.description: Joins equal ropes (designed for tape). No crossings.
knot.zustrichna_visimka.name: Figure-8 bend
knot.zustrichna_visimka.description: Joins ropes of the same diameter. No crossings, free ends exit diagonally opposite.
knot.akademichnyi.name: Surgeon's-type bend
knot.akademichnyi.description: Joins ropes of different diameters. Symmetric; the loaded end presses the unloaded one. Needs 2 control knots.
knot.bramshkotovyi.name: Double sheet bend
knot.bramshkotovyi.description: Joins ropes of different diameters. Two turns. Needs 2 control knots.
knot.providnyk_visimka.name: Figure-8 on a bight
knot.providnyk_visimka.description: Loop (attachment point). No crossings; loop at most 20 cm from the knot.
knot.providnyk_visimka_odnym.name: Figure-8 follow-through
knot.providnyk_visimka_odnym.description: Loop tied with one end — the correct knot to tie into the harness. No crossings; loop ≤ 20 cm.
knot.serednii_providnyk.name: Alpine butterfly
knot.serednii_providnyk.description: Mid-rope loop for a middle member. Symmetric, no crossings; isolates a damaged section.
knot.podviinyi_providnyk.name: Double figure-8 loop
knot.bulin.name: Bowline
knot.bulin.description: Attaches to a support. The free end may exit on either side. Needs 1 control knot.
knot.stremeno.name: Clove hitch
knot.stremeno.description: Attaches to a support or carabiner. Both ends are loaded — they must be connected.
knot.stremeno_odnym.name: Clove hitch (one end)
knot.stremeno_odnym.description: Attaches to a support, tied with one end. Only one end is loaded — a control knot is needed.
knot.shtyk.name: Half hitches
knot.shtyk.description: Attaches to a support: at least 3 half hitches in the same direction; more than 5 — no control knot needed.
knot.shtyk_tonka.name: Half hitches, thin support
knot.shtyk_tonka.description: Thin support (diameter ≤ rope diameter): first hitch doubled; 3 hitches need a control knot, 4 or more are safe.
knot.shtyk_tovsta.name: Half hitches, thick support
knot.shtyk_tovsta.description: Thick support (diameter > rope): second hitch doubled; 3 hitches need a control knot, 4 or more are safe.
knot.karabinna_udavka.name: Releasable carabiner hitch
knot.karabinna_udavka.description: Attaches to a support and can be released from below by pulling the figure-8. Only around a support at least 2 carabiner lengths thick (the carabiner must not be cross-loaded).
knot.prusik.name: Prusik
knot.prusik.description: Grabbing knot: ≥ 2 turns, symmetric; cord:rope diameter ≈ 1:2; both ends loaded — ends joined (a loop).
knot.prusik_odnym.name: Prusik (one end)
knot.prusik_odnym.description: Grabbing knot with one end: ≥ 2 turns; one end loaded — a control knot is needed.
knot.avstriiskyi_skhopl.name: Austrian grabbing hitch
knot.avstriiskyi_skhopl.description: Grabbing: ≥ 3 turns; slides one way, grips the other; ends joined.
knot.bakhmana.name: Bachmann hitch
knot.bakhmana.description: Grabbing on a carabiner: ≥ 3 turns; ends joined.
knot.uiaa.name: Munter (Italian) hitch
knot.uiaa.description: Braking knot for belay and descent on a locking HMS carabiner. Know the loading direction; the moving strand works on the side opposite the gate sleeve.
knot.garda.name: Garda hitch
knot.garda.description: Self-locking hitch on two identical carabiners. Feeds rope one way only and locks under load — unsuitable for belaying from below.
knot.rating.correct: “{knot}” is the correct knot for this situation.
knot.rating.wrong: “{knot}” is the wrong knot for this situation: it will most likely not hold a shock load.
knot.rating.dangerous: “{knot}” is dangerous here: it will untie or slip under load.
knot.msg.needs_carabiner: This knot is acceptable only through a locking carabiner.
knot.msg.missing_control: Without a control knot “{knot}” can untie: +25% chance to fail under a shock load.
knot.msg.prefer_double_control: A single control knot meets FSTU rules, but the school prefers a double one.
knot.msg.turns_below_min: Too few turns: at least {min} needed, {turns} made.
knot.msg.constant_load_only: “{knot}” works only under constant load — a shock load can pull it apart.
knot.msg.cord_too_thick: A {cord} mm cord on a {rope} mm rope (ratio {ratio}) is too thick — the knot will not grip.
knot.msg.cord_too_thin: A {cord} mm cord on a {rope} mm rope (ratio {ratio}) is too thin — it may slip or cut.
knot.msg.cord_not_looped: This grabbing knot needs a cord loop (ends joined), but the cord is not tied into a loop.
knot.msg.carabiner_missing: This knot needs a locking carabiner.
knot.msg.two_carabiners: The Garda hitch needs two identical carabiners.
knot.msg.support_too_thin: The support is too thin for this knot: the carabiner would be cross-loaded.
knot.garda_blocks_feed: The Garda hitch cannot feed rope: on a belay from below the leader cannot move further from the belayer.

cmd.take_in.hint: Ask the belayer to take in the slack.
cmd.secured.hint: The member is self-secured at a base. The belay may now be removed.

rule.P1: {member} started moving on belay before {belayer} shouted “Belay on!” («Страховка готова!»).
rule.P3: {member} used the fixed rope before “Fixed rope ready!” («Перила готові!»).
rule.P4: Too many members on one fixed rope segment ({count}).
rule.P5: A rock fell without the “Rock!” («Камінь!») warning.
rule.P6: {member} removed the belay before {climber} shouted “I'm secured!” («Сам!»).

event.rope_fixed: {member} fixes the rope to the base (“{knot}”).
event.rope_doubled: {member} rigs the rope doubled around the anchor.
event.base_built.sling: {member} builds a base: sling around the anchor + locking carabiner.
event.base_built.direct: {member} sets up the anchor as a base (the rope will be tied directly around it).
event.base_built.bolt: {member} clips a carabiner into the bolt — the base is ready.
event.belay_set.lower: {member} sets up a belay from below for {climber}.
event.belay_set.upper: {member} sets up a belay from above for {climber}.
event.unclipped: {member} unclips the rope from the base.
event.base_dismantled: {member} dismantles the base and takes the gear.
event.items_passed: {member} passes {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to {to}.
event.items_picked: {member} picks up {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}.
event.command_misunderstood: {member} shouted something unclear — the command «{command}» was not understood.
event.fall.knot_failed: FALL! The “{knot}” failed under load — {member} falls.
event.fall.pulled: FALL! {member} is pulled off the stance.
event.caught.belay: The belay caught {member}: a {length} m fall.
event.slid_to_node: {member} slid {distance} m on the carabiner to the lower end of the fixed rope — will have to climb again.
event.belayer_distracted: {member} was busy with something else — {climber} had no belay!
event.belayer_pulled: Belayer {member}, not anchored to a base, is pulled after {climber}!
event.rock_warned: “Rock!” was heard — {count, plural, one {# member takes} other {# members take}} cover.
event.rock_hit: The rock hit {member}{helmet, select, 1 { — the helmet softened it} other { — no helmet!}}.
event.took_cover: {member} takes cover from the rock and skips the step.
event.game_won: The whole team is at the finish! Victory!
event.game_lost_injury: A member is injured — the game is lost.
event.game_lost_steps: Step limit ({max}) exceeded — the game is lost.
reason.already_clipped: the rope is already clipped to this base
reason.base_exists: there is already a base here
reason.base_in_use: the base is in use (ropes, self-belays, belay)
reason.bolt_needs_carabiner: a bolt base needs a carabiner
reason.climber_not_tied_in: the climber is not tied in
reason.double_needs_coil: only a coiled rope can be rigged doubled
reason.garda_blocks_feed: the Garda hitch does not feed rope
reason.grab_needs_rope: a grabbing knot goes on a rope
reason.hand_busy: the hand already holds the rope
reason.item_not_carried: the item is not carried by this member
reason.item_not_on_ground: the item is not on the ground
reason.lanyard_arms_used: all lanyard arms are in use
reason.no_rope_end_near: the climber's rope end is not nearby
reason.not_below_rope: you must stand below the anchor, along the rope
reason.not_releasable: the rope cannot be pulled down: it is neither doubled nor on a releasable hitch
reason.not_safe_position: only possible in a safe place (start/finish/summit zone or secured at a base)
reason.not_secured_to_base: the belayer is not secured to a base
reason.rope_clipped: the rope is still clipped to intermediate bases
reason.rope_not_carried: this member does not carry the rope
reason.rope_spread_out: the rope is spread out — be near all of its points
reason.secured_to_base: secured to a base — detach first
reason.segment_end: end of the fixed rope segment — clip to the next one
reason.still_on_belay: still on belay: self-secure and shout «Сам!» first, then untie on the next step
reason.too_heavy: the maximum weight would be exceeded
hint.belay_next_step: The belay protects from the next step on. First “Belay on!”, then move.
hint.belay_not_effective_yet: The belay was just set up — it does not protect in this step yet.
hint.body_belay_steep: Belaying without an anchor on steep ground: a fall can pull the belayer off.
hint.carabiner_slides: A carabiner-only self-belay does not hold in place: in a fall you slide to the lower end of the rope.
hint.crowded_segment: More than one member on the segment overloads the rope.
hint.detach_last_protection: This is your last protection on steep ground!
hint.hand_no_protection: Holding the rope by hand gives no protection — it only helps balance.
hint.small_tree_anchor: A thin tree is a questionable anchor.
hint.unprotected_here: It is steep here and the member is not protected.
hint.wait_belay_ready: The belayer has not shouted «Страховка готова!» — until then the belay does not hold.
hint.wait_fixed_rope_ready: Nobody has shouted “Fixed rope ready!” yet.
hint.wait_secured: The climber has not shouted “I'm secured!” yet.
